name: seo-traffic-airlock
title: SEO Traffic Airlock
description: Read-only SEO preflight for autonomous agents: audit a candidate robots.txt and preview redirect rules before anything is deployed. Runs fully offline - zero network egress, nothing is written or sent.
author: rohan

commands.name: seo.audit_robots_txt
commands.title: Audit robots.txt Before Deploy
commands.description: Evaluates a candidate robots.txt locally with RFC 9309 matching (wildcards, $, longest match wins) and flags site-wide or homepage blocks before anything is deployed. Zero network egress.

robots_txt.label: robots.txt contents
robots_txt.help: Paste the full candidate file. An empty value means allow-all.

user_agent.label: Crawler to evaluate as
user_agent.help: Product token such as Googlebot, Bingbot or *.

commands.name: seo.preview_redirect_graph
commands.title: Preview Redirect Graph
commands.description: Analyses proposed redirect rules locally: finds loops, self-redirects, conflicting targets, chains (with flattened suggestions) and oversized batches. Zero network egress.

redirect_rules.label: Redirect rules
redirect_rules.help: One rule per line (or separated by ;): /old -> /new. A JSON list of {source, target} also works (max 5000).
